# Nexvert

> Nexvert (https://nexvert.online) is a free online file converter with 185+ browser-based tools for PDF, images, audio, video, archives and developer data. Files are processed on the user's own device with browser APIs and WebAssembly (ffmpeg.wasm, Tesseract OCR, pdf-lib, pdf.js) instead of being uploaded to a server. No account, no watermark, no installation.

## Key facts
- Price: free, no sign-up, no watermarks.
- Privacy: conversions run locally in the browser; file contents are not uploaded. Anonymous page-view analytics (Google Analytics) is used on the website itself.
- Platforms: any modern browser on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS.
- Limits: per-tool file size limits (typically up to 100 MB for images and PDFs, 200 MB for audio, 500 MB–1 GB for video) set by device memory, not by a paid plan.
- Formats: 50+ including PDF, DOCX, EPUB, Markdown, HTML, CSV, JSON, XML, YAML, JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, GIF, BMP, SVG, MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, MP4, WEBM, MOV, ZIP, TAR.

## PDF & document tools

- [Convert DOCX to Plain Text](https://nexvert.online/docx-to-text/): Extract raw text from Microsoft Word (.docx) documents without XML markup or formatting bloat.
- [Convert Markdown to HTML](https://nexvert.online/markdown-to-html/): Compile Markdown (.md) documents into clean, semantic HTML elements with instant live preview and syntax styling.
- [Convert HTML to Markdown](https://nexvert.online/html-to-markdown/): Convert HTML web pages and markup snippets into clean Markdown format with customizable heading and bullet styles.
- [Convert Markdown to PDF](https://nexvert.online/markdown-to-pdf/): Render Markdown notes directly into clean, vector-rendered PDF documents with pagination, custom margins, and headers.
- [Convert CSV to Markdown Table](https://nexvert.online/csv-to-markdown/): Transform CSV spreadsheets and TSV tables into clean, formatted Markdown pipe tables with column alignment.
- [Convert HTML to Plain Text](https://nexvert.online/html-to-text/): Strip HTML tags, scripts, and CSS styling to extract clean, readable plain text from web pages and emails.
- [Convert EPUB to Plain Text](https://nexvert.online/epub-to-text/): Extract the chapter text of DRM-free EPUB ebooks into a single readable plain-text document.
- [Convert EPUB to HTML](https://nexvert.online/epub-to-html/): Extract and assemble EPUB ebook chapters into a single readable, formatted HTML web document.
- [Convert JPG to PDF](https://nexvert.online/jpg-to-pdf/): Convert JPG photos and graphics into clean PDF document pages.
- [PDF Merger](https://nexvert.online/pdf-merge/): Merge multiple PDF files into one single organized PDF document.

- [Remove PDF Pages](https://nexvert.online/remove-pdf-pages/): Delete unwanted or blank pages from your PDF document with live visual preview checkboxes.
- [Add Page Numbers to PDF](https://nexvert.online/add-page-numbers/): Stamp customized sequential page numbers with flexible positioning, starting offsets, and styles.
- [Watermark PDF](https://nexvert.online/watermark-pdf/): Stamp custom text watermarks across all pages with opacity, rotation, and color settings.
- [PDF Metadata Editor](https://nexvert.online/pdf-metadata-editor/): Read and update document Title, Author, Subject, Keywords, Creator, and Producer properties.
- [Fill PDF Form Fields](https://nexvert.online/fill-pdf-form/): Detect AcroForm inputs, type into text boxes, toggle checkboxes and dropdowns, and download.
